title: The Diagonal Dilemma
author: Gene Hubert
problems: Row 7 "ones gyre 1½ - end facing down with the first robins on the LEFT" isn't drawn yet.

Row 3 "circle left 3 places and a little more to a diamond with first larks facing up, first robins facing down, twos on opposide sides · circle" can't start from where the dancers are: Nobody is called "sides" here.

Row 3 "circle left 3 places and a little more to a diamond with first larks facing up, first robins facing down, twos on opposide sides · diamond" can't start from where the dancers are: Nobody is called "sides" here.
